# Orion Private Wealth Consulting

> Orion Private Wealth Consulting connects discerning clients with the world's most exclusive properties, luxury vehicles, and timepieces — privately, efficiently, and with absolute discretion.

Orion Private Wealth Consulting is a private consulting firm based in Florida, USA, serving clients globally. The firm operates as a trusted network providing access to luxury real estate (UAE, Engadina, Cote d'Azur), rare luxury automobiles, and exclusive timepieces.

## Pages

- [Home](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/): Overview of Orion's mission and services.
- [Who We Are](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/who-we-are): Background on the firm and its philosophy.
- [Services](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/services): Details of the consulting services offered.
- [Markets](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/markets): Regions and markets served.
- [How It Works](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/how-it-works): The client engagement process.
- [Partners](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/partners): Overview of Orion's private partner network.
- [FAQ](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/faq): Answers to frequently asked questions about Orion's services, including dedicated clusters on luxury real estate in Dubai (#real-estate), collector automobiles (#automobiles), and luxury timepieces (#watches).
- [Insights](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/blog): Articles and insights from Orion.
- [Contact](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/contact): How to request a private consultation.

## Blog Posts

- [Buying Luxury Real Estate in Dubai: A Guide for International Investors](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/blog-dubai-real-estate-guide): Freehold areas, the Golden Visa, real costs beyond the listed price, and remote due diligence for international property buyers.
- [Acquiring a Collector Automobile: The Private Path to Authenticity and Discretion](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/blog-collector-automobiles-guide): Provenance verification, auction versus private sale, importing across borders, and bespoke manufacturer access.
- [Luxury Timepieces: A Guide to Acquisition and Discreet Sale of a Collection](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/blog-luxury-timepieces-guide): Authenticating a rare or vintage watch, boutique waitlists, and how to sell a collection with discretion.
- [Switzerland vs. the French Riviera: A Tax Comparison for Second-Home Buyers](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/blog-switzerland-riviera-tax): A tax comparison between Engadina and the Cote d'Azur for second-home buyers.
- [Buying Off-Plan in Dubai: What International Buyers Need to Know](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/blog-dubai-off-plan): Payment plans, escrow protection, and developer due diligence for off-plan purchases.
- [Why Success-Fee Models Change the Incentive Structure in Luxury Brokerage](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/blog-success-fee-model): How success-fee compensation aligns intermediary incentives with client interests.
- [Timepieces as an Asset Class: What Collectors Should Know Before Buying](https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/blog-timepieces-asset-class): Rarity, condition, provenance, and authentication for watch collectors.

## Languages

This site is available in English (default), Russian (/ru/), Ukrainian (/uk/), and Arabic (/ar/, right-to-left). All pages listed above have full translations at the corresponding language-prefixed path, e.g. https://orionprivatewealthconsulting.com/ru/faq.html.

## Notes

This is a static business marketing website. All content referenced above is public marketing information; no private client data is exposed on these pages.
